questions.q: Consider the following statements about the India-Netherlands agricultural cooperation meeting:
items: The bilateral meeting was held in New Delhi on 28th September 2026.
Both nations reviewed the progress of 25 Centres of Excellence in agriculture and horticulture.
The Netherlands delegation was led by Prime Minister Dick Schoof.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.why: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the Dutch delegation was led by Agriculture Minister Silvio Erkens, not the Prime Minister.
